name: Data Analyzer: Health check stays fast while a file analysis is running
objective: Shows the server can still answer its health check quickly while a file analysis is in progress, so one heavy request does not freeze everyone else.
precondition: Server application run inside the offline test harness with a made-up API key. A deliberately slow (1.5 second) stand-in replaces the real work, so no real network and no AI model are used.

steps.action: Start a file analysis upload (the work is replaced by a stand-in that blocks for 1.5 seconds).
steps.expected: The request is running in the background.

steps.action: After 0.3 seconds, call the health check while that request is still in flight.
steps.expected: Health returns HTTP 200 in under 0.7 seconds, and the slow request was still unfinished when health answered; when it finishes it returns HTTP 200.
